svg.title: White on Black
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-relief-paintings-05-2001/lightbox/works/white-on-black-2001-12576; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
